prerequisites: Completion of modules in the study areas Computer Science Basic Modules, Computer Science Advanced Modules, and Mathematics Basic and Advanced Modules
At least 114 ECTS credits acquired in total

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to work on a comprehensive task from the field of computer science using scientific methods under guidance and to present the results appropriately in writing.

syllabus_topics: Supervised processing of a problem from computer science using scientific methods.
Independent work on the posed problem.
Appropriate presentation and classification of the procedure and results in a written thesis.
assessment_rules: Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program. In case of failure, a total of 2 attempts are available for the examination.
